name: JingleLark
summary: Writes radio jingles from a line of text, lets you pick a voice, and mix intro, bed and outro for free; credits pay for voiceovers.
description: JingleLark is an AI jingle maker for small radio stations and DJs: you type a line, pick a radio voice, and mix it with an intro, bed and outro. Mixing and downloads are always free; voiceovers use credits that never expire, with full commercial rights and MP3/WAV download. Every voice is included on every pack.

pricing.details: Mixing and downloads always free; one-time packs Starter 13 €, Standard 35 €, Pro 88 €.
pricing.label: Freemium
